plugins.name: bash-guard
plugins.description: Asks for explicit confirmation before destructive shell commands (rm -rf, force push, DROP TABLE, ...)

plugins.name: chat-index
plugins.description: A CHAT-INDEX button above the prompt: drafts this chat's index row (title, date, one-line summary) for review, then has Claude append it to the user's chat index

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A bar above the prompt showing how full the context window is, with a nudge to compact past 85%

plugins.name: data-peek
plugins.description: A side pane profiling every CSV/TSV Claude reads or writes: columns, types, missing values, min/mean/max and a sparkline

plugins.name: lang-guard
plugins.description: Notices when Claude answered in another language than the prompt (Hebrew, Russian, English) and offers to re-answer

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: A 'second opinion' button above the prompt: another model critiques Claude's last answer in a pane, and one press sends the critique back to fix it

plugins.name: session-cost
plugins.description: The session's cost so far in the status line

plugins.name: turn-done
plugins.description: A toast and a desktop notification when a long answer finishes

plugins.name: usage-bars
plugins.description: Two bars above the prompt: 5-hour and weekly usage with reset time in Hebrew
